ranAgainst: the Task 1 commit 8807d4a (cleanupAttended and attendedSettings unchanged from the plan base) plus the new cleanupAttended and attendedSettings cases in test/unit/live-harness-hygiene.test.ts. The forged fixtures use only temp directories: cleanupAttended takes the home and the temporary directory as a second argument, and the tests pass two temp directories, so the real home is never named (the plan's idea of using the real home as the forged evidenceDir would have deleted it at this base, since the base trusts the fixture).
reason: At base cleanupAttended trusts the fixture: for a profile directory outside the default parents, a link out of its parent, an evidence directory outside the temporary directory and the temporary directory itself it removes the directory and does not throw (assert.throws: 'Missing expected exception.'). For a profile directory without the fixture tag and for a created parent that is not a default parent it fails before the intended check, on rmSync(parent, { recursive: false }) raising EISDIR, so the expected refusal message is not produced. The full removal case also fails on that EISDIR: the base cannot remove a created parent at all (rmSync on a directory without recursive always raises EISDIR). attendedSettings still allows `Bash(cat:*)`, `Bash(head:*)`, `Bash(git log:*)`, `Bash(git diff:*)` and `Bash(git show:*)`, so the exact-git assertion and the no-write-rule assertion fail.
